entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You know how people will pray before[n]filming movies, so that it'll go smoothly?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Should we try praying to the gods, too?[n]It could be about us.
For the Phantom Thieves?
For better grades?
...What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah. For the future of the Phantom[n]Thieves.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey! They're not so bad I have to ask for[n]divine intervention!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No, I want to pray for the future of the[n]Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: O-Oh, uh, don't get the wrong idea![n]I meant "us," like, the Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, but... I don't really know how to[n]pray properly.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What should I do? Maybe I'll ask[n]someone...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Excuse me! Can I ask you a question?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Hmm... What a surprise, seeing you in[n]a place like this.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Are you on a date? Such an odd location[n]for someone your age.
We're friends.
We go to school together.
And you?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Is that so? Well, not that I care.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Hmm... Well, not that I care.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Minor business, I guess?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Hmm... Is that so? I'll make you tell me[n]the truth later.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I'll need the details later, my little[n]guinea pig.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: So you won't deny it... That's awfully bold.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Um... Is this someone you know,[n][fName]?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Don't worry about me. I don't intend to[n]intrude.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Oh... I assume you're here for your college[n]entrance exams. You had mentioned them[n]before.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Shake the bell twice and put in your[n]offering. Then bow twice, clap twice,[n]and bow once again.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Wasn't that what[n]you wanted to ask?
I'm impressed you knew.
You really helped us out.
You're amazing, doc.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Thank you very much.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait, you're a doctor!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, you really helped us out.[n]Thank you very much.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Sure. Although... You may want to[n]use this time to actually study for[n]the exams instead of praying.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Exams...? Wait, I think I recognize her...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's the doctor who gets us[n]our medicine.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, I see... Wait, you've been here[n]the whole time!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How rude! I'm here to protect you!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, sure... Anyway, what is this about[n]praying for college entrance exams?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We asked earlier if she could get us some[n]super stimulants to help us study.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ah, I see.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Wait... Wouldn't the gods be mad to[n]get a visit from a cheater?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Thanks for today. Let's go home.
